lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots extending from the branchial region to the caudal peduncle. The spots posterior to the gills are smaller and more densely clustered before transitioning into a regular staggered grid along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a lattice-like pattern where the highest-intensity blobs reside at the intersection nodes, particularly visible in the mid-body region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank. They exhibit a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with higher-intensity pixels on the dorsal-facing edge and lower-intensity shadow pixels on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, low-contrast spots concentrated near the leading edge and base of the first dorsal fin's silhouette; the upper posterior region of the fin appears mostly devoid of high-luminance patterning.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch or indentation is present on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin. Several small, high-luminance punctate marks are visible along the trailing edge of the upper caudal lobe, possibly indicating minor scarring or epidermal abrasions.
other_distinctive_markers: Two remoras (Echeneidae) are attached to the ventral flank just posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point.
